roots.title: Specialized Continuous and Large-Scale Methods
roots.top_down_role: Adaptive-depth structural navigation for Specialized Continuous and Large-Scale Method; formal statements are stored in a later sidecar layer.

children.title: Derivative-Free Optimization
children.top_down_role: Optimization using function-value, comparison, simulation, or related black-box information, covering local and global methods, structural regimes, stochastic evaluations, constraints, and zeroth-order complexity.

children.title: Manifold Optimization
children.top_down_role: Optimization over finite-dimensional smooth manifolds, emphasizing intrinsic and embedded representations, deterministic and stochastic methods, structured matrix and tensor manifolds, optimality theory, complexity families, computational interfaces, and geometric failure regimes.

children.title: Distributed Optimization
children.top_down_role: Optimization models and methods in which objectives, constraints, data, computation, or decision authority are distributed across communicating agents.

children.title: Continuous Lagrangian-Block Decomposition Synthesis
children.top_down_role: Continuous large-scale decomposition interfaces based on coupling relaxation, block reformulation, value-function projection, and dynamic master generation; model-specific LP, stochastic, mixed-integer, and splitting implementations retain their primary homes elsewhere.

children.title: Scenario-Splitting Decomposition Interface
children.top_down_role: Navigation for scenario-oriented stochastic-programming decomposition, ADMM-oriented separable optimization, their shared computational interfaces, and their principal applicability and failure boundaries.

children.title: Mathematical-Programming Decomposition Regime Family
children.top_down_role: Navigation across mathematical-programming decomposition contexts that interface with continuous decomposition methods; foundational LP, MIP, stochastic-programming, and monotone-operator theory remain in their owning chapters.

children.title: Matrix-Free Second-Order Solver Family
children.top_down_role: Large-scale second-order optimization through implicit derivative actions, subspace linear algebra, constrained saddle-point systems, reduced-memory curvature representations, and their computational reliability boundaries.

children.title: Fixed-Point Solver Acceleration
children.top_down_role: Acceleration of fixed-point and residual-based solvers, including relaxation, anchoring, extrapolation, Anderson-type methods, splitting interfaces, complexity theory, and failure control.
